split_policy.primary_axis: behavior phase before benchmark workload, comparative baseline, raw sample packet, report root, or claim class
split_policy.positive_rule: performance rows can cite canonical behavior only through parser, sema, lowering, IR, runtime, or e2e owners
split_policy.provenance_rule: raw samples, report roots, artifact roots, package staging, machine profiles, tool versions, and comparative baselines are provenance-only and never define Objective-C 3 behavior support
split_policy.retired_surface_rule: compatibility, fallback, shim, old-mode, unsupported, wrapper-only, local-only, report-only, cross-machine universal, screenshot-derived, and hand-normalized claims are canonical rejection, strict-error, or provenance-only evidence
